Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Mojave-Inspired Decorative Throw Pillow Cover, 20" x 20", Blue and Red
Colors: Blue/Red
Bring a striking global touch to your room with a high-contrast pillow cover. Intricate details in the layered yarns give it a chunky, satisfying texture. 20"x20" Front: 43% Recyled Cotton, 28% Olefin, 14% Acrylic, 13% Polyester, 2% Cotton; Back: 55% Linen, 45% Rayon Insert not included Pillow cover features a zipper closure Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry.
